messages:
Incident Bot: ALERT: Elevated packet loss and latency observed from eu-west egress to provider-X (AS64500). Threshold breached 4.2% packet loss in the past 2m. Auto-pager sent.
Samir: acknowledged. Paging in. starting investigation. any customer reports? :eyes:
Jordan: seeing spike in 5xxs for a subset of customers in eu-west-lb-2, routing errors in app logs correlate with time of loss.
Priya: looking at perf dashboards — tail latency +200ms and timeouts to external APIs via provider-X.
Samir: first step: confirm with BGP view. @NetOps Bot can you run a quick bgp-summary to provider-X from sfo and dublin?
NetOps Bot: running bgp-summary against AS64500...
NetOps Bot: output snippet:
```
$ netops bgp-summary --peer AS64500
-- sfo-peer: prefixes accepted 28k, best path change rate: 0.1/s
-- dublin-peer: prefixes accepted 28k, best path change rate: 3.8/s <-- HIGH
-- eu-west-egress-1: up, high pktloss observed from host probes
```
Samir: dublin peer seems to be oscillating. Jordan can you run tcpdump from eu-west-egress to provider-X IPs and dump 30s? capture might show retransmits.
Jordan: started tcpdump on eu-west-egress-1 (pid 3421). grabbing 30s.
Carlos: I see duplicate ack/retrans patterns in the pcap. looks like microflaps at provider level causing packet reordering.
Priya: DNS lookups to some upstream resolvers are timing out too; wondering if path asymmetry causing ECMP/uneven shaping.
Samir: mitigation options: 1) withdraw more-specific routes to force alternate transit 2) prepend to make provider prefer other path 3) shift customer traffic via backup transit 4) coordinate with provider-X. thoughts?
Ava: preferring option 3 short-term — shift egress for impacted prefixes to backup transit (AS64499). lower blast radius.
Samir: agreed. Jordan, prepare route-maps to shift https://ops/runbook#egress-shift (short windows). I'll announce to provider.
Jordan: applying temp policy to tag impacted-customer prefixes with community no-export and set next-hop to backup transit. command:
```
conf t
route-map SHIFT-EU permit 10
 match ip address ACL-IMPACTED
 set ip next-hop 10.200.1.1
 set community 64499:100 no-export
exit
```
Jordan: policy applied on eu-west-egress-1 & eu-west-egress-2. now withdrawing more specifics to provider-X where applicable.
NetOps Bot: BGP updates: ORIGIN changes seen. Announcement to backup transit in progress.
Samir: monitoring — dashboards?
Priya: within 90s we see drop in packet loss to 0.3% for impacted prefixes. tail latency recovering. customers on impacted buckets showing success rate back to 99%. :thumbsup:
Samir: nice. open ticket with provider-X support: ticket# PX-98765, contacted NOC via email and phone. logged timeline.
Carlos: provider-X replied: "we're seeing internal link flap between peering-3 and transit-aggregation causing transient reorders, our infra team has a mitigation rolling."
Ava: good to have confirmation. keep shift for 15m past stabilization then revert.
Jordan: scheduling revert in 20m with gradual rollback (canary prefixes first). revert plan in case we see relapse: reapply and escalate.
Samir: on-call handoff to Jordan at +30 min for monitoring and ensures revert. I'm staying until stabilize.
NetOps Bot: Incident annotated: severity=sev2; impact=partial egress packet-loss for subset eu-west customers; mitigation=temporary egress shift to backup transit; ticket=PX-98765.
Priya: adding customers list and support notes to incident board.
Samir: summary for postmortem: cause = provider-X internal link flap causing route churn and asymmetry; detection = automated packet probes + customer error spikes; mitigation = temporary egress shift to backup transit + provider coordination; next steps = request RCA from provider-X, add automated failover to backup transit for affected AS next time, add synthetic checks for reordering.
Ava: I'll own follow-up for automation (runbook -> automated egress diversion).
Jordan: will keep monitoring for 1h and send final status to #incidents.
Samir: thanks all. closing thread when provider confirms stable and we've reverted. :white_check_mark:
